subject.title: fix(compaction): prevent repeated restarts after safety timeouts

question: After the shared timeout helper is restored, should OpenClaw accept one marked native compaction result produced immediately after safety-timeout cancellation while the exact timeout reason remains inside its bounded settlement window?
rationale: Source and proof establish the mechanics, but changing timeout-aborted work from always fail-closed to conditionally persisted session state is an intentional product reliability tradeoff requiring owner intent.

options.title: Accept bounded timeout commits
options.body: Restore the shared helper, retain the exact-reason settlement window, and merge after current-head checks prove the sibling runtime and session lifecycle.

options.title: Keep native timeouts fail-closed
options.body: Retain inner chunk partial-summary preservation and timeout guidance but remove the AgentSession post-timeout acceptance path.

options.title: Require live slow-provider proof
options.body: Keep the PR open until a realistic gateway or slow-provider run proves the bounded commit path without duplicate or late session mutation.

recommendation.title: Accept bounded timeout commits
recommendation.body: Restore the shared helper, retain the exact-reason settlement window, and merge after current-head checks prove the sibling runtime and session lifecycle.

likelyOwner.reason: He is the assigned reviewer and has the strongest recent history in the compaction timeout and shared-helper surfaces involved in this decision.
